# descope_inbound_app_attribute (Resource)

Manages a single inbound app custom attribute definition in a Descope project.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The immutable machine name that identifies the attribute. This value is called `Machine Name` in the Descope console, and JWT templates read an inbound app's value for it as `{{app.customAttributes.<id>}}`. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `name` (String) The display name of the attribute. This value is called `Display Name` in the Descope console.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project that this inbound app attribute belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `type` (String) The type of the attribute. Choose one of "string", "number", "boolean", "singleselect", "multiselect", "date", "monthday". Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.

### Optional

- `select_options` (Set of String) The list of options to choose from when the attribute type is "singleselect" or "multiselect".
